1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the first alarm and second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time interval, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor that is perceptually distinct from the first alarm.
